subject: Calendar lattice: legal + procurement handoff for MSA redline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@undertow.io>, Daniel Ortega <procurement@undertow.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Nov 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Calendar lattice: legal + procurement handoff for MSA redline

Hi Ava / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick intake on the MSA. To get us across the finish line next week, can we lock a time for a focused redline call (legal + procurement + one product ops lead)? We expect this to be technical/contracting detail only — 40–60 minutes.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Fri 2028-11-10, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Fri 2028-11-10, 15:00–16:00 PT
- Mon 2028-11-13, 09:00–10:00 PT

Agenda (30–40 min redline; optional 20 min handoff):
- Quick intro and roles (5m)
- Walk through outstanding tracked changes and key commercial asks (20–30m)
- Action items: evidence deliverables, DocuSign path, target signature runbook (10m)

Attachments: Undertow_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (redline with our comments), procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx (we've prefilled some items). Please confirm which window works and who from your side will attend (procurement contact + counsel recommended).

If none of these work, send two windows that suit your calendar and we will accommodate. I'll circulate a calendar invite once we confirm.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Program Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
(Attachment: Undertow_MSA_redline_v3.pdf, procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx)

Kimberly —

Thanks, appreciate the clear windows. Quick note from procurement side: our legal counsel will only be available for short windows on Friday afternoon. We think a tight 30–40 minute contract redline followed by a separate onboarding ops call makes the most sense. Proposed from our side (PT):
- Fri 2028-11-10, 15:30–16:10 PT (preferred)
- Fri 2028-11-10, 16:30–17:10 PT (fallback)

Also we need the following artifacts before the redline session so our procurement team can verify controls: SOC2 report summary (recent), API retention/ingress policy, and a brief diagram of data flow for hosted inference. Can you confirm if those are available? If yes, please share links or a secure folder.

Attendees: Daniel Ortega (procurement), me (Ava Simmons), external counsel TBD. I will confirm counsel availability by EOD.

—Ava

Hi team —

I can join the Fri 11/10 afternoon slot but would prefer a 40 minute focused session rather than 30 if possible; we typically need time to call out any commercial vs. IP/indemnity items. A couple quick asks from legal before the call so we can be prepared:
- Please upload the redline PDF to a shared Drive folder (tracked changes + a clean copy).
- Share the latest SOC2 summary and encryption/KMS outline; procurement already asked for retention policy — add the data-retention-policy.pdf if you have one.
- If Undertow expects any special subcontractor approvals, list them in the Drive notes.

If Ava's counsel is only available for a short window, we can triage the most material clauses (liability cap, data protections, breach notice, indemnities) and resolve the rest in EDIs.

I'll leave the final scheduling to Kimberly — please confirm final time and I will block my calendar.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Legal - Contracts
markus_klein@redwood.com

Hi Ava / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick replies and the artifact ask; we can provide the SOC2 summary and retention policy before the call. I uploaded a Drive folder and pasted the link in the calendar invite (see related_links).

Confirmed slot: Fri 2028-11-10, 15:30–16:10 PT (40 minutes redline + optional 15 minute ops handoff immediately after for any onboarding items). Calendar invite will go out in 5–10 minutes — please accept if that works.

Pre-call checklist for Undertow: attach counsel name and email to the invite, confirm any vendor controls that require pre-approval (Markus copied), and add specific clauses you want prioritized in the calendar event description.

I'll attach the procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx with our prefilled notes and the redline link in the invite. If anything changes, ping me and we'll pivot.

See you Friday —
